items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Tom Owens; the mention is made by the interviewer.

ctx.x: ... by a fellow named Tom Owens, who worked about 10 years on this dissertation which, when it finally came in, was about 1,000 pages long - and half of it was a series of transcriptions of several hundred transcriptions

and the upshot of his research was that by looking at several hundred of these transcriptions of Parker, what he did was isolate 100 very short, melodic figures, which Parker would use over and over and over again, but in innumerable numbers of combinations.
